title: CWP/12870/2025 of DARSHAN DEVI AND ORS Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND ORS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of decision: May 07, 2025 Darshan Devi and others ….Petitioners versus State of Haryana and others ….Respondents CORAM: HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE SUDHIR SINGH HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE ALOK JAIN Present:- Mr. Nishant Maini, Advocate for the petitioners. Mr. Ankur Mittal, Additional AG Haryana with Mr. Gaurav Bansal, DAG Haryana and Mr. Karan Jindal, AAG Haryana. Mr. Ankur Mittal, Advocate for respondents No.2 and 3. SUDHIR SINGH, J. (ORAL) Present Writ Petition herein, inter alia, is for issuance of a Writ in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondents to allot an alternative plot to the petitioners of the same size in the same sector or adjoining sector, as the originally allotted plot is under litigation/ dispute/ non-possessionable, and the petitioners’ entitlement to alternative plot is duly covered under the HSVP’s policy dated 06.08.2024 (Annexure P-6), thereby necessitating appropriate relief.

2. At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners would be satisfied, in case, their pending representation dated 1 of 2 02.05.2025 (Annexure P-5) is considered and decided by respondent No.2, which has not been adverted to by the respondents till date.

3. On the other hand, on advance service of copy of petition, learned counsels for the respondents appear and oppose issuance of notice of motion. They submit that grievance of the petitioners will be looked into by respondent No.2 and it shall take decision either way, on the pending representation dated 02.05.2025 (Annexure P-5) of the petitioners.

4. Given the nature of order being passed, there is no necessity to seek reply by any of the respondents as no further proceedings and/or pleadings are required.

5. Without commenting on merits of the case, the petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.2 to consider the pending representation dated 02.05.2025 (Annexure P-5) of the petitioners and pass an appropriate reasoned order, in accordance with law, at the earliest, preferably within a period of 08 weeks from the date of receipt of copy/ production of this order.

6. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of. (SUDHIR SINGH) JUDGE (ALOK JAIN) JUDGE May 07, 2025 mahavir 2 of 2
